en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a hilly town with dense trees and multiple multi‑story houses with steep roofs nestled in a valley. On the slopes above the town stand a few prominent villas or large houses. The foreground shows a cluster of older buildings, while the background is dominated by wooded hills. Printed red text at the lower right reads "Ober-Tharandt." and at the very bottom appear publisher details in smaller type.
